# unpacking_the_world

> A paste-first decoder that runs entirely in the browser. JWTs, PEM keys,
> X.509 certificates, cron expressions, HTTP header/cookie blocks, timestamps,
> UUIDs, HTML entities, URLs, Base64 and archives (zip, tar, tar.gz) are decoded
> locally. Nothing is uploaded, there is no analytics and there is no sign-up.

## Canonical pages

- [unpacking_the_world](https://unpackingtheworld.com/): what the tool does, free
  vs Pro, and the FAQ.
- [Decoder](https://unpackingtheworld.com/app): the tool itself.
- [Privacy](https://unpackingtheworld.com/#privacy): no upload, no tracking, no
  third-party requests; files are read in the tab and discarded.
- [Terms](https://unpackingtheworld.com/#terms) and
  [refunds](https://unpackingtheworld.com/#refunds).

## What it does

Free: JWT (header, claims, expiry and signature check), Base64, URL, HTML
entities, Unix timestamps, UUIDs, PEM basics.

Pro: X.509 certificate inspection, nested decoding chains, cron expression
explanation, User-Agent parsing, HTTP header/cookie analysis, archive peeking,
local history and offline use. Pro is a one-time AppSumo licence stored in the
browser; entitlements are verified offline from a signed token.

## Limits worth knowing

- Archives are capped at 200 MB compressed, 64 MB per entry and 512 MB expanded.
- Inputs over 2 MB are not auto-detected, to keep the tab responsive.
- Decoding is local, so there is no server-side API to call.
